import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world/world.sqlite')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cur = conn.cursor()

def dump(name):
    print(f"\n===== {name} =====")
    for r in cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {name}"):
        d=dict(r); d.pop('_assertion_id', None); print(d)

for t in ['elevator_intake','bin_transfer','ticket_named_on_move','elevator_loadout','carrier_departure','mill_intake','mill_process','location']:
    dump(t)

print("\n===== groundings sample =====")
for r in cur.execute("SELECT kind, reference, count(*) c FROM _world_groundings GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2"):
    print(dict(r))
